# Resource: catalyst_smarttrain_material

Experimental. Manage a URL-based training material for an existing ConvoKraft SmartTrain bot in Development. Requires an explicit organization and `ZIAPlatform.Convokraft.RAG.CREATE`, `.READ`, and `.DELETE`. Use a public HTTPS URL for material you intend the bot to learn. Create waits for the material record to be visible; training continues asynchronously. A URL or title change replaces the material, and deleting a record removes its trained knowledge. Import as `project_id/bot_id/material_id`, then configure the canonical URL reported by Catalyst. Verified offline.

## Environment Isolation

An explicit provider organization is required. The computed `routing_scope` binds
this resource to its data center, environment and organization. Changed routing is
rejected before resource API calls, including when applying a saved creation plan.
Refresh legacy state under its original routing before updating or deleting it.
See [environment isolation and migration](../guides/environments.md).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "catalyst_smarttrain_material" "example" {
  project_id = var.project_id
  bot_id     = var.bot_id
  title      = "Terraform onboarding guide"
  url        = var.material_url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Argument Reference

### Required

- `bot_id` (String) Existing Development bot ID with SmartTrain enabled.
- `project_id` (String) Existing Development project ID.
- `title` (String) Title of the training material.
- `url` (String, Sensitive) Public HTTPS URL of the HTML or text training material. Stored in Terraform state.

## Attribute Reference

- `id` (String) Material ID as an exact numeric string.
- `routing_scope` (Attributes) Saved data center, environment and explicit organization routing. Provider routing must match before reads, plans or mutations. Legacy state binds only after a successful refresh with the original routing. This records configuration, not authenticated caller identity. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--routing_scope))
- `status` (String) Latest training status reported by Catalyst, when available.

<a id="nestedatt--routing_scope"></a>
### Nested Schema for `routing_scope`

Read-Only:

- `data_center` (String)
- `environment` (String)
- `organization_id` (String)

## Import

Use the same provider data center, organization and environment as the existing
resource. Import reads the object into state; review the next plan before apply.

### Import Command

```shell
terraform import catalyst_smarttrain_material.example PROJECT_ID/BOT_ID/MATERIAL_ID
```
